# NEW 2026-11-24 v25.0 Colonization 4.0 (oe_col4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v250_colonization4.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Balanced Native American Great Pestilence Frontier Contraction Disaster (T1).
# Keeps imperial cores (AZT/INC) intact for historic gameplay while allowing devastated peripheral tribes
# to contract or revert to migratory societies organically.
oe_col4_pestilence_collapse = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/ciompi_revolt.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = 0.25

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		culture = { is_culture_native_american = yes }
		government_type = government_type:tribe
		country_has_disease = disease:great_pestilence
		num_locations >= 3
		stability < 55
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		NOT = { tag = AZT }
		NOT = { tag = INC }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_collapse_concluded }
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:great_pestilence }
			AND = {
				stability >= 50
				NOT = { country_has_disease = disease:great_pestilence }
			}
			num_locations <= 1
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		stability_investment = -0.10
		global_monthly_prosperity = -0.005
		global_monthly_control = -0.005
		global_food_capacity_modifier = -0.15
	}

	on_start = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col4.10
	}

	on_end = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_collapse_concluded value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col4.13
	}

	on_monthly = {
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				12 = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							num_locations >= 2
							any_owned_location = {
								is_capital = no
								population < 2.5
							}
						}
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col4.11
					}
				}
				4 = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							num_locations <= 2
							total_population < 3.0
							NOT = { country_type = pop }
						}
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col4.12
					}
				}
				84 = { }
			}
		}
	}
}
